Former Brazil and Inter Milan defender Maicon to visit Kolkata for youth football initiative
 The former Brazil international will visit Kolkata as King Sports Management’s global brand ambassador and interact with young footballers as part of a talent development programme.
 Updated : Oct 28, 2026 23:21 IST , CHENNAI - 1 MIN READ

 Former Brazil international and Inter Milan defender Maicon will visit Kolkata on November 13 and 14 as part of a grassroots football development initiative organised by King Sports Management.
 The 45-year-old will arrive on November 13 and attend a series of events at the Biswa Bangla Convention Centre the following day. He is also scheduled to interact with young footballers during a talent identification programme.
 ALSO READ | National Junior Athletics Championship: Tamil Nadu takes overall title 
 Maicon made 76 appearances for Brazil between 2003 and 2014, featuring in the 2010 and 2014 FIFA World Cups.
 The former right-back was a key member of Jose Mourinho’s Inter Milan side that won the historic treble of Serie A, Coppa Italia and UEFA Champions League in the 2009-10 season.
